material_roles.clay_face: 悬首式恐怖脸不适用；这是死寂兵俑：额部、眼窝、鼻口、下颌有主次的灰陶面，保持秦汉军士身份。眼不必发光。
material_roles.fired_clay: 陶躯与小腿：完整灰褐陶面、关节少量积灰；不随机撒裂纹。
material_roles.lamellar: 胸背甲、肩袖、护胫与低盔：按整个甲面组织少量横向札片接缝；盔口适当暗，非每个方块同宽白边。
material_roles.undercloth: 腰腹、上臂、大腿内衬：较暗但不纯黑；纵向衣褶，避免与陶腿和甲片混成同一种灰。
material_roles.binding: 腰带、绑腿、握杆束带：深暖褐；接缝与真实受力位置对应。
material_roles.old_bronze: 盔脊、带扣、枪套和尾鐏：低饱和旧铜；少量边缘亮，不使用全身亮金。
material_roles.haft: 长兵木杆：沿长轴纹理，握持位置稍暗，不能四面同样年轮。
material_roles.blade: 枪刃：沿现有刃形组织刃口/暗脊；实际朝前是+Z；不要改武器几何。
material_roles.recess: 预留色，仅在真实内面与接缝使用，不画假空洞。

uv_direction: 6-face UV rectangles frozen; wall V top-to-bottom. Caps and rotated segments must follow exported per-face UV and cube rotations. Direction check is temporary, remove for final.
texture_ownership: Model source only writes temporary-material-atlas.png, never the production PNG. Final author updates real PNG and bbmodel embedded texture; keep UV lock intact.
lod: 56/45/24 cubes; identical hierarchy and shared atlas regions.
handoff_notes: 当前面部只有材料区块，不是完成贴图。
贴图作者不要参考日式/西式阵营符号；画廊只借鉴分层、握持与材质组织。
从临时图改成正式图必须同步BB嵌入纹理；源脚本会保留非临时嵌入图。

orientation_contract.software_preview_coordinate_conversion: Gecko-style X reflection only; Z unchanged. Front camera yaw180 looks toward -Z, i.e. sees +Z face.
orientation_contract.warning: Do not translate along local -Z or add an extra Y180. That would reverse the stance-speed agreement. If caller rotates by Y180 for any other convention, rotate velocity with the same matrix too.
orientation_contract.evidence_scope: Static code audit of source geo, local ScenicModels wrapper, software foot-contact math and upstream 1.20.1 Forge renderer/factory source. No native bake or game executed; main native orientation check still required.
